title: internal Cindy knowledge delegate

goal.text: Complete one dispatched Cindy knowledge finalization through its generated assignment subplan.

requirements.summary: Claim the dispatched job, deliver its knowledge outcomes through the supplied template, and report the result. The runtime owns canonical binding and matching delegate closeout.
acceptanceCriteria: Only a successful claim authorizes work on this job.
Assignments meet their evidence, scope and outcome contracts; partial and no-edit results are reported honestly.
The canonical result is persisted and the runtime confirms matching delegate closure or reports why closure is deferred.

tasks.title: Claim the ready Cindy knowledge job
tasks.detail: Use the claw-kit Ghost knowledge.claim operation with the exact finalization id supplied by dispatch. Retain claimToken, templatePath, assignments, and immutable configuration. If the originating report has not yet persisted, retry the same claim; if claimed is false, do not edit project knowledge.

tasks.title: Execute the assignment subplan
tasks.detail: Use the claw-kit Ghost subplan.create operation with templateFile returned by knowledge.claim. Session focus supplies the parent plan and current task. Follow returned guidance and carry out the assignment outcomes yourself.

tasks.title: Persist the terminal result
tasks.detail: Submit Ghost knowledge.done with finalizeId, claimToken, and status plus result (succeeded) or error (failed). Report success only for completed outcomes; a corrected no-effect command error is not an unresolved failure. The runtime persists the result and closes this claim-owned delegate when safe. If delegateClosed is true, stop without additional lifecycle calls. If closure is deferred, inspect the reported canonical state; do not replay an accepted or outcome-unknown mutation or finish an unrelated plan.

rules: Use only the supplied finalization id, claim token, and generated assignment template.
Do not modify the supplied plan or report materials.
Do not start another finalizer or delegate the assignments to another agent.

Correct known no-effect errors within the current work. An unresolved prerequisite blocks dependent writes, not read-only inspection or an honest partial-result report. Never replay accepted or outcome-unknown mutations.
